claims.head: Penalties could cost the Sharks
claims.call: The Oilers’ power play creates at least their usual 9.5 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Sharks’ penalty kill sits 24th in the league, and the Oilers’ power play is 1st (9.5 expected goals per 60). Discipline matters more than usual for the Sharks tonight.

claims.head: The Sharks’ goalie is in for some dangerous shots
claims.call: The Oilers’ average shot has at least their usual 6.6% chance of going in.
claims.body: The Oilers make their shots count (10th in the league: a 6.6% chance of scoring on the average shot), and the Sharks are 29th at preventing dangerous shots. Expect the Oilers to get some real chances.

claims.head: Bodies will fly
claims.call: The two teams’ combined hit score reaches their usual 113.
claims.body: The Oilers have a hit score of 110 (8th in the league) and the Sharks 116 (4th), where 100 is league average after adjusting for each arena’s scorer. Keep your head up.

claims.head: Don’t blink and you still might miss the shots
claims.call: The game runs at fewer than 78.3 shots per 60 at 5-on-5, slower than either team’s usual.
claims.body: Edmonton plays some of the league’s slowest games (24th for pace: 80.1 shots per 60 at 5-on-5, both teams combined), and so does San Jose (29th). We think this one is even quieter than either team’s usual.

notes.text: M. Savoie has not played this season. L. Draisaitl is in his usual spot beside C. McDavid and V. Podkolzin. That line is getting 12:18 a game at 5-on-5, up from 9:11 with Savoie.
K. Kapanen has started playing on the power play: on the ice for 56% of the team’s power-play time in 4 games, up from 6% last season.

SJS.head: San Jose faces a real test
SJS.body: Edmonton has controlled the play far better over recent games and San Jose has home ice. San Jose can pull it off if they pounce on loose pucks.

EDM.head: The matchup suits Edmonton
EDM.body: Edmonton has controlled the play far better over recent games and San Jose has home ice. San Jose can make it interesting if they pounce on loose pucks.
